recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen execution and poor food quality
recommendations.action: Implement standardized recipe cards, conduct daily pre-shift taste tests, and audit ingredient quality from suppliers.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food-related complaints and improved flavor consistency across all shifts.

recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude, understaffing, and lack of customer service training
recommendations.action: Launch a mandatory customer service training workshop and institute an employee appreciation program to reduce burnout and turnover.
recommendations.expected_impact: Boosted staff morale, friendlier guest interactions, and a noticeable drop in service-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Long wait times and operational bottlenecks during peak hours
recommendations.action: Redesign kitchen and service workflows, optimize scheduling for peak hours, and implement a digital POS-to-kitchen routing system.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster ticket times, reduced table turnaround friction, and improved overall throughput.

recommendations.issue: Poor cleanliness standards in the establishment
recommendations.action: Establish strict, checklist-based opening, mid-shift, and closing cleaning routines with mandatory manager sign-offs.
recommendations.expected_impact: Elevated hygiene standards and immediate removal of cleanliness-related negative reviews.

recommendations.issue: Dissatisfaction with pricing relative to perceived value
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive menu engineering audit to review portion sizes, presentation, and ingredient value, adjusting prices or enhancing plating where necessary.
recommendations.expected_impact: Better alignment between guest expectations and menu pricing, leading to increased perceived value.
